purpose: Define installation ordering as explicit deterministic sequencing for installation stages, including cs root and numeric ordering, without confusing install order with semantic authority or runtime execution order.

topics.name: Install Order
topics.purpose: Define installation ordering as explicit deterministic sequencing for installation stages, including cs root and numeric ordering, without confusing install order with semantic authority or runtime execution order.

semantics.order_rule: Install stages use declared numeric/order metadata.
semantics.semantic_rule: Install order is lifecycle sequencing, not ownership/authority precedence.
semantics.validation_rule: Each stage validates prerequisites before applying.
semantics.failure_rule: Failure stops or rolls back according to explicit installer transaction policy; later stages do not silently proceed.
semantics.activation_rule: Installed does not automatically mean enabled/running unless lifecycle contract explicitly says so.

invariants.rule: Boot selection, pruning, dependency validation and activation are explicit; the runtime never silently enables missing dependencies.

hard_gates.condition: filesystem enumeration order used as install order
install order treated as semantic authority precedence
later stage proceeds after failed required prerequisite
numeric order omitted where deterministic order is required

references.purpose: Installed and enabled/running states remain distinct.
